headline: His work has had a direct impact on our growth and market position.
quote: Over the past 2 years Ben has played a key role in creating Accufix Surgical's marketing strategy. He helped us define our value proposition, built our website, managed our social and paid media efforts, and created essential sales materials for our team. He has also provided invaluable advice and consultation for Accufix, as a startup medical device company. His work has had a direct impact on our growth and market position.
name: John Evans
